title: Ribbon Cutting: Pregnancy Resource Center
seo_title: Pregnancy Resource Center Ribbon Cutting in Republic, MO
description: The Republic Area Chamber of Commerce is hosting a ribbon cutting for the Pregnancy Resource Center on November 13, 2026, from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM Central Time. The event takes place at 291 U.S. Hwy 60 W in Republic, Missouri. It is listed under business networking and community events.
